jobs.description: Developing digital tools for the company’s land bank, including a land management information system.
achievements: Developed site and construction modelling based on specified parameters and master plans, and a dashboard for analysing land reserves by project.
Built a temporary housing management system and a flexible role-based access model with an administration interface.
Implemented event-driven calculation of ownership shares in land plots, buildings and premises, with bitemporal data storage for cost allocation.
Built an engineering and business knowledge portal with MCP access.
Improved DXF processing, support for local coordinate systems and intersection calculations between land plots and construction objects.
Optimised services to reduce p95 response times. Configured application deployment and operations in Kubernetes, including configuration, secrets, resources, networking and diagnostics.
Conducted technical interviews, onboarded developers and served as acting team lead.

jobs.description: Worked on a startup within admitad GmbH: an embeddable furniture selection widget for partner websites in the US rental housing market.
achievements: Developed a step-by-step furnishing flow, selected-item management and rental request submission.
Implemented rental cost estimates based on furniture types and quantities, rental duration and rates.
Built the host component for the widget.
Integrated Google Analytics and Yandex Metrica to track user journeys.
Developed an interface for configuring furniture company integrations with the rental service.

jobs.description: Developed a service for shipping goods from China.
achievements: Built staged order processing and consolidation of a customer’s parcels into a single shipment at the warehouse in China.
Implemented shipping estimates based on weight, dimensions, transport method and rates.
Integrated Mindbox for targeted promotions and online payments for account top-ups.
Developed order management, including adding items, editing shipping parameters and viewing change history.

jobs.description: Built a web system for centralised intake and processing of service requests from corporate and advertising websites.
achievements: Implemented a partner portal with access controls and detailed request information.
Built an administration panel for data flows, filters, priorities and processing limits.
Automated request distribution among partners based on region, source and content, taking priorities and limits into account.
Implemented real-time updates via Socket.IO, processing statistics and Excel report exports.
Integrated DaData to determine regions from phone numbers, and API-based data exchange with external systems with transfer status display.

jobs.description: Developed web services, online stores and administration panels.
achievements: Created a Telegram and WhatsApp messaging service with Android device management through a web administration panel.
Migrated the canoe.ru clothing store from CSR to SSR.
Built the WE-AR administration panel for augmented reality markers.
Developed a Kazakhstan multisite platform with articles about loans and data from the central bank.
Built a Barcelona coffee shop website and an online DVPL converter for World of Tanks.
